verdict.rationale: Brevo's ecommerce API documents syncing orders and attributing revenue to campaigns, which covers revenue-to-email attribution beyond opens and clicks. The evidence is a single marketing-level line. It does not show attribution to automation flows or attribution of signups. Custom event tracking exists but is not described as attribution. Missing for 10: attribution of revenue to automation flows/workflows, signup or conversion attribution to specific emails, documented attribution model and reporting depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks

citations.quote: Sync products, categories, and orders. Track customer behavior and attribute revenue to campaigns.
